text.en: Dog owners praise trainer Mike for his friendly demeanor, deep behavioral knowledge, and clear coaching style. Clients highlight that his welcoming approach puts both nervous rescue dogs and first-time handlers at ease during private lessons and training sessions.

Reviewers report noticeable improvements in impulse control, household communication, and managing leash reactivity or resource guarding. Pet parents appreciate practical exercises that empower owners to continue structured training effectively on their own.

Clients emphasize how well the training channels high puppy energy and accommodates reactive companion dogs safely. Lessons focus on positive reinforcement rather than punitive techniques, helping dogs feel secure around young children and unfamiliar outdoor settings.

q.en: What training methodology does All Canines use?

a.en: The trainer uses positive reinforcement techniques that work with each dog's energy rather than forceful corrections.

q.en: Are private lessons and in-between coaching available?

a.en: Yes, clients mention personalized one-on-one sessions alongside a convenient text line for ongoing advice between meetings.

q.en: Can training assist with reactive or fearful rescue dogs?

a.en: Reviewers specifically highlight significant behavioral improvements for rescue dogs struggling with anxiety, reactivity, and guarding habits.
